headlines.description: Cameron Wake sacked Andy Dalton for a safety with 6:38 left in overtime, and the Miami Dolphins beat the Cincinnati Bengals 22-20 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins prevail in OT on Wake's safety sack

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Linebacker Tamba Hali and cornerback Sean Smith returned turnovers for touchdowns in extending the Kansas City Chiefs' perfect start to nine straight games with a 23-13 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs improve to 9-0 with win against Bills

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw for 337 yards and two touchdowns, including the go-ahead score to Dwayne Harris with 35 seconds left, and the Dallas Cowboys beat the Minnesota Vikings 27-23 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo rescues Cowboys with late TD pass

events.name: Tennessee Titans at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Chris Johnson ran for 150 yards and two touchdowns and the Tennessee Titans beat former coach Jeff Fisher and the St. Louis Rams 28-21 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans rumble past Rams as Johnson shines

events.name: New Orleans Saints at New York Jets

headlines.description: Nick Folk remained perfect this season by kicking four field goals, and Rex Ryan's defense outperformed twin Rob's unit as the New York Jets upset the New Orleans Saints 26-20 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets stymie Brees en route to upset of Saints

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Darrel Young scored on a 4-yard run in overtime Sunday, the third touchdown of the game for the little-used fullback, giving the Washington Redskins a 30-24 win over the San Diego Chargers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins slip Chargers in OT behind Young

headlines.description: Cam Newton overcame a shaky start, throwing for one touchdown and running for another as the Carolina Panthers beat the Atlanta Falcons 34-10 Sunday for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers rout Falcons for 4th straight win

headlines.description: Nick Foles tied an NFL record with seven touchdown passes and threw for 406 yards to revitalize a struggling offense for the Philadelphia Eagles in a 49-20 victory over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles ties NFL mark with 7 TDs as Eagles roll

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Steven Hauschka kicked a 27-yard field goal with 8:11 left in overtime, and the Seattle Seahawks staged the biggest rally in franchise history, overcoming a 21-point deficit to beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 27-24 in overtime on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks shake 21-point deficit for OT win

headlines.description: Jason Campbell threw three touchdown passes -- two to Davone Bess -- and the Cleveland Browns ended an 11-game losing streak against Baltimore, beating the wobbling defending Super Bowl champions 24-18 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns best Ravens for first time in 12 tries

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Brady throws for 4 TDs; Pats top Steelers 55-31
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady tosses 4 TDs as Pats trounce Steelers

headlines.description: Kubiak collapses, Colts rally to beat Texans 27-24
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts shrug 18-point deficit to trump Texans

events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Josh McCown won the battle of the backups after Aaron Rodgers was hurt, getting lots of help from Brandon Marshall and Matt Forte to give the Chicago Bears a 27-20 win over the Green Bay Packers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCown guides Bears as Pack lose Rodgers
